cutoffPolicy: Extends nearest-1000 unchanged and stores only additional rows. Applies its exclusions (SIMBAD ** aggregates, BD? candidates, reviewed membership exclusions) and ranks the remaining corrected CNS5 objects by nominal J2000 distance then stable ID. Objects curated by another catalog keep that record and ID. Rank 4000 is LP 772-31 at 24.159723369060 pc; next is RX J1943.4-3722 at 24.159923572877 pc.
description: Nearest-1000 release plus the next 4000 individual stellar/substellar objects from corrected CNS5 with exact SIMBAD, Gaia DR3, 2MASS and literature enrichment.
label: Nearest 5000 + companions
snapshot: J2000.0; CNS5 corrected 2023-12-13; SIMBAD, Gaia DR3, 2MASS and VizieR TAP frozen 2026-10-25; source-defined snapshot, not a completeness claim.
